summary: Marisela Silva Parra is the only woman in Los Exploradores, a WWF-supported group documenting natural resources on farms near Colombia’s Chiribiquete National Park. Despite initial opposition from her husband and other women, she became the group’s secretary and has encouraged other women to participate in community action. The region faces deforestation linked to land grabbing, cattle ranching and illegal mining. Silva says forests must be preserved and restored. WWF-Colombia’s Carlos Mauricio Herrera says the group’s work helps develop information and skills to protect forests and coordinate conservation efforts.
